watch.story: Record profit R$12.6B, ROE 23.6%. Brazil rates/election + currency risk - insist on full discount.

deep.name: Itaú Unibanco (Brazil bank)
deep.money: Lending (net interest ~R$33B/quarter), fees (cards, asset mgmt), insurance. Loan book ~R$1.5 trillion.
deep.moat: Cheapest funding in Brazil (millions of accounts), best underwriting (overdue loans ~half the market's), very efficient (spends 37 cents per R$1 of revenue).
deep.record: Recurring profit R$46.8B in 2025 (+13%); ROE 19-23% every year; Q3 2026 R$12.6B (+6.7%), ROE 23.6%.
deep.strength: Capital ratio (CET1) 12.7% - extra cushion; bad loans 2.0%; strong liquidity.
deep.risks: 1) Brazil 2027 slowdown - Itaú itself expects tougher credit. 2) Brazilian real falling vs US$. 3) Fintech competition + Brazil taxes (10% withholding on dividends to foreigners from 2026).
deep.scenarios: Bear ~-3% to 0%/yr · Base ~8-10%/yr · Bull ~14-16%/yr (5 years, from US$7.34)
deep.canada: Buy NYSE ADR 'ITUB' in US$ (use your USD to avoid 1.5% FX fee). Brazil tax on dividends is lost in a TFSA; claimable in non-registered.
deep.why: Highest-quality bank of the group at ~9x earnings. Brazil + currency risk = start with a half-size position; add only if 2027 credit holds up or price falls further.

deep.name: CGI (Montreal IT services)
deep.verdict: ✅ BUY SMALLER (half size, at buy price)
deep.money: Running clients' IT systems on multi-year contracts (55%) + consulting/systems projects (45%). Revenue C$16.6B.
deep.moat: Switching costs - governments/banks can't easily replace who runs their core systems. C$32B backlog (~2 years of revenue).
deep.record: Revenue C$12.1B (2021) -> C$16.6B (2026); EPS C$6.04 -> C$8.58 (~9%/yr); steady 11% net margin; ~C$2.1B free cash flow/yr.
deep.strength: Net debt ~C$3.8B (rising, used for buybacks) but manageable vs C$2.5B/yr cash flow.
deep.risks: 1) AI shrinking paid IT hours (stock fell ~40% on this). 2) Organic growth only ~2%; EPS helped by debt-funded buybacks. 3) Government spending cuts / losing big contracts.
deep.canada: Buy 'GIB.A' on TSX in C$ - no FX fee, no foreign tax. Best in TFSA.
deep.why: Clear quality business at ~10-11x earnings if it hits C$91; AI question unanswered = start half size and add if growth improves. Don't chase at today's price.
